name: 19350 · Landenberg, PA
findings: ZIP 19350 (Landenberg) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19350 (Landenberg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19350 (Landenberg) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
